# Priit Linnakivi

> Priit Linnakivi offers modern web development and quick computer repair services in Paide.

## Services

- [Veebiarendus ja arvutite abi](https://priitlinnakivi.eu/): Comprehensive web development and computer support for users and businesses.
- [Veebilehtede loomine](https://priitlinnakivi.eu/): Learn how to create effective and functional websites.
- [Arvutite remont](https://priitlinnakivi.eu/): Get assistance with computer repairs and maintenance.

## Featured Examples

- [MaireArt](https://maireart.eu): A portfolio website showcasing visual and professional presentation in art.
- [Maire Rasta](https://mairerasta.eu): A personal and branded website suitable for professional representation and contact info.
- [Molecule Master](https://moleculemaster.eu): An educational website focused on scientific topics with a clear structure.
